title: Derived finite reductions of a completed coefficient line are ordinary reductions
statement:
For any rank-one locally free completed coefficient module L, the derived reduction of L[0] is isomorphic to the single complex of its ordinary scalar reduction at every positive level. Together with [lem-pur-completed-line-complete], the same object is derived complete. No particular root sheaf is used.

theorem completedLine_derived (S : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (L : SheafOfModules.{u + 1}
      (WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E S))
    (hL : L.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank 1)
    (D : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{d}) (hl : l ≠ D.p) :
    letI := WeilConjectures.integralCoefficientAbLocallyBijective.{u, u} S
    (∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty
      ((WeilConjectures.integralDerivedReduction.{d, u, u} l E S D hl n).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj L) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsOfUniverses.{u, u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
            (WeilConjectures.completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted.{u, u} l E S n) L))) ∧
    WeilConjectures.IsDerivedComplete.{d, u, u} l E S D hl
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj L)

proof.text: Choose a good K-flat flat-term complex by the proved K-flat resolution theorem. The existing integralLineTensorComparison_representative supplies K-flatness of L[0]. Apply integralDerivedReductionKFlatIso. The singleMapHomologicalComplex isomorphism moves the ordinary tensor functor inside the single functor. Its defining object equality identifies it with ordinary scalar extension; the old and universe-independent versions have the identity sectionwise tensor isomorphism, whose naturality follows on pure tensors. Sheafify and apply the single functor. Completeness is the separate source step 11.
